definition: [ דָּלַח ] verb make turbid (Assyrian dalâ—u , disturb , Zim Bp 81 also in derivatives; Palestinian ᵑ7 דְּלַח figurative be anxious, fear , turbavit, conturbavit ) — Qal Imperfect 2 masculine singular, וַתִּדְלַח Ezek 32:2 3 feminine singular suffix תִּדְלָחֵם Ezek 32:13 + v Ezek 32:13 ( Co תרפשׂם ); — stir up, trouble, make turbid (always with feet ) followed by מים Ezek 32:2 (|| תִּרְפֹּס , — ס Baer , and not שׂ ); so Ezek 32:13 a, b (but v Ezek 32:13 b. Co reads תרפשׂ (compare v Ezek 32:2 ) for תדלחם ).
